text: ポケモンセンターに　あずけると　つかれて　うごけない　ポケモンも　げんきに　なるよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンセンターに　あずけると
structure.en: if you leave them at a Pokémon Center

structure.jp: つかれて　うごけない　ポケモンも
structure.en: even Pokémon too tired to move

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'if' or 'whenever', with a result that always follows. あずけると = 'if you leave them'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかれて　うごけない　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed before a thing, describes that thing. つかれて　うごけない　ポケモン = 'Pokémon that are tired and can't move'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing うごく to うごける gives 'can move'; with ない it is 'cannot'. うごけない = 'can't move'.
